Subject: Onboarding: required PO info + SKU mapping (Nebula Analytics)

Hi Neha,

Thanks again — we're excited to get Redwood live for our analytics pipelines. We pulled together the onboarding form and the price schedule for Q3. A couple of ask-items on our side before we can wire purchase orders in our system:

- We need a single PO number that will cover the initial committed spend for the pilot (we call out spend cap below). If you issue a provisional PO, please include the start/end dates and a billed-to address.
- Line item mapping: your price schedule uses "Compute Unit - short", "Compute Unit - long" and a separate "KV cache" SKU. Our AP team needs to know which of those map to our internal SKU codes (see column C in the attached price schedule).
- Spend cap: Nebula's procurement policy requires a dollar limit linked to the PO. For the pilot we expect to allocate $45,000 over 90 days; confirm if Redwood can apply a spend cap against that PO.
- Billing note: Can Redwood include cost-center and GL code fields on the PO so we can automate invoice matching? Our preferred GL is 5207.

I'm attaching: Nebula_Onboarding_Form.pdf and Nebula_PriceSchedule_Q3.xlsx.

Let me know the PO number format you use and any extra forms we should complete.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Operations
Nebula Analytics

Hi Elena — thanks for the attachments and the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Ops) and Karthik (Finance) to confirm the PO matrix and spend-cap behavior. Quick answers while they weigh in: 

- We can issue a provisional PO in the format RW-PO-<6 digits> and include start/end dates and billed-to.
- Spend caps: Redwood can enforce a soft spend cap tied to the PO for hosted customers; for hard enforcement we need a Dedicated/Reserved arrangement. For a pilot we can set an alert threshold and a hard stop if approved by Finance (Karthik).
- Line items: we'll need to map your internal SKU column to our price schedule SKUs — Marissa, can you take ownership of the SKU mapping and reply with a proposed mapping file?
- GL/Cost center: we can surface GL and cost-center on the PO fields; they are not mandatory for our backend but we'll include them in the PDF that we issue for your AP team.

I'll aim to have a provisional PO number and an initial mapping spreadsheet by EOD today pending Karthik's confirmation on the spend cap enforcement.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
